name: VeriScore
why_it_matters: Newsrooms need reliable ways to check whether AI-generated claims and statistics can be substantiated against authoritative online sources.
task_shape: Extracts verifiable claims from long-form model outputs, retrieves web evidence via search, and scores each claim as supported or unsupported to produce a factual precision and recall metric.
signals: Focuses on verifiable claims in long-form generation rather than short QA, closer to real reporting workflows.
Relies on web search snippets as ground truth, so quality depends on retrieval and may miss claims requiring paywalled or database sources.
